title: BUGFIX — spielberg/batch-run.ts: fix JSON parse error when running Godman demos
description: All 7 Godman code-demo batch runs fail with SyntaxError at position 1. Root cause: index.ts outputs pretty-printed JSON (multi-line). batch-run.ts line 76 filters lines starting with '{' and joins them, producing invalid concatenated JSON when nested objects span multiple '{'-prefixed lines. Fix: use lastIndexOf('\n{') to find the last top-level JSON object boundary and parse from there.

tasks.title: Fix JSON parsing in runDemo() in scripts/spielberg/batch-run.ts
